sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior conditional-branch, corrected QUDT namespace, and direct xsd:integer survivalCraftAvailableCapacity instructions. The candidate still uses FILTER NOT EXISTS over one complete satisfying tuple, so it does not faithfully encode the required presence-and-comparison checks and can permit accidental passes through tuple existence/alternative bindings. Rewrite the SPARQL violation logic so that, when applicability is true, all five declared inputs/results are explicitly required and correctly typed, survivalCraftAvailableCapacity is compared directly against personsCapacityRequirement + additionalEquipmentCapacityRequirement, and launchingApplianceCapacity is compared in kg against loadedSurvivalCraftRequirement; any missing, ill-typed, or failed operand/comparison must select the ship as a violation.
